description: This file contains definitions for difficulty levels, detailed prompt templates, and functions to generate medical exam questions and validation prompts for an AI-based medical education platform.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt for creating high-quality medical multiple-choice questions based on difficulty, context, and image information.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating the quality and accuracy of generated MCQs, including scoring and issue identification.
